{{Short description|American mathematician}}
'''W. Stephen Wilson''' is a mathematician based in [[Johns Hopkins University]] specializing in [[homotopy theory]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.math.jhu.edu/~wsw/|title=Math Dept Home Page of W. Stephen Wilson|website=Math.jhu.edu|accessdate=7 June 2016}}</ref>

Wilson received his Ph.D. from [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]] in 1972 under the supervision of [[Franklin Paul Peterson]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=20544|title=W. Stephen Wilson}}</ref>

In 2012, Wilson became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list|title=American Mathematical Society|website=Ams.org|accessdate=7 June 2016|archive-date=25 August 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180825194636/http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list|url-status=dead}}</ref>
